title: East Jerusalem Palestinians Mount Legal Battles Against Displacement
detail: Palestinians in East Jerusalem are pursuing legal challenges to remain in their homes amid sustained Israeli displacement pressures and continued settlement expansion. Families face eviction proceedings and administrative hurdles as Israeli authorities advance plans in contested neighborhoods.

title: Israeli Forces Conduct Sweeping West Bank Raids; 13 Palestinians Detained
detail: Israeli forces carried out wide-ranging raids across the West Bank, torching a prayer room and attacking farmers. At least 13 Palestinians were detained including arrests in the Jenin and Nablus areas. Raids encompassed multiple villages and involved both military and settler-related incidents.

title: Israeli Settlers Set Fire to Mosque in Occupied West Bank
detail: Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque in the occupied West Bank, in the latest incident of escalating settler violence against Palestinian communities. The arson attack is part of a broader pattern of settler attacks on Palestinian property and religious sites.

title: UN Formally Demands Israel Do More to Stop Settler Violence in West Bank
detail: The United Nations formally demanded that Israel take stronger action to stop settler violence in the West Bank. The UN call comes amid a surge in settler attacks on Palestinian villages, agricultural land, and religious sites across the occupied territory.

media.caption: UN demands Israel do more to stop settler violence in the West Bank

title: Israeli Strike Kills Woman in Gaza City as Ceasefire Marks One Year
detail: An Israeli air strike on an apartment in Gaza City killed a Palestinian woman on October 14. Israel said it was investigating and claimed the target was a Hamas member, without providing evidence. Gaza's Health Ministry reports at least 1,481 Palestinians killed since the October 2025 truce; talks on the second phase (Israeli withdrawal, Hamas disarmament) remain stalled.
